definitions.explanation: A constraint on how much time is allowed for an activity, stay, or process. Commonly applied to dining, parking, exams, and various services.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時間制限|じかんせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This exam has a time limit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧90{分|ぷん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時間制限|じかんせいげん}です。
examples.english: The all-you-can-eat has a 90-minute time limit.

examples.japanese: {時間制限|じかんせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦だらだら→だらだら：05843_daradara⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまいがちだ。
examples.english: Without a time limit, people tend to work in a lazy, drawn-out way.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time) and ⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (limit, restriction). A very practical term encountered frequently in everyday Japanese life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間制限|じかんせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — there is / is no time limit
- {時間制限|じかんせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧ — to set a time limit
- {時間制限|じかんせいげん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ — with a time limit
- {時間制限|じかんせいげん}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — within the time limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{制限時間|せいげんじかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧ — time limit (same meaning, reversed word order; more commonly used for exams and competitions)
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ — deadline, expiration date (for submissions, payments, products)
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧ — deadline (especially for work submissions)

NOTE ON WORD ORDER:
{時間制限|じかんせいげん} and ⟦{制限時間|せいげんじかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧ are often interchangeable, but ⟦{制限時間|せいげんじかん}→制限時間：30577_seigenjikan⟧ tends to emphasize the specific allotted time ("the allotted time is 60 minutes"), while {時間制限|じかんせいげん} emphasizes the existence of the restriction itself ("there is a time limit").
